shader_resources.RTV1_fragment_source:
#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; uniform sampler2D sampler0; uniform sampler2D sampler1; uniform vec4 inputColor; uniform float numTiles; uniform vec2 grain; uniform vec2 grainOffset; in vec2 offset; in float opacity; in vec2 tilt; in vec2 direction; in vec2 fragCoord; const float radius = 0.5; vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5); out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { vec2 texCoord = vec2(fragCoord.s / numTiles + offset.x, (1.0 - fragCoord.t) / numTiles + offset.y); float a = texture(sampler0, texCoord).r; if (a == 0.0) discard; vec2 grainTexCoord = vec2((gl_FragCoord.x - grainOffset.x) / grain.x, (gl_FragCoord.y - grainOffset.y) / grain.y); float grainAlpha = texture(sampler1, grainTexCoord).r; if (grainAlpha <= 0.0) discard; float mag = dot(vec2(fragCoord.s - 0.5, 0.5 - fragCoord.t), tilt) / 0.5; float gradationMin = abs(dot(direction, tilt)) + 0.5; if (gradationMin > 1.0) gradationMin = 1.0; float gradationAlpha = (gradationMin - 1.0) / 2.0*mag + (1.0 + gradationMin) / 2.0; float alpha = a * opacity * gradationAlpha; if (alpha <= 0.0) discard; alpha = alpha * alpha + alpha * grainAlpha * (1.0 - alpha); if (alpha <= 0.0) discard; float dist = distance(center, fragCoord.xy); float pixelDist = fwidth(dist) * 1.0; float smoothAlpha = 1.0 - clamp((dist - (radius - pixelDist)) / pixelDist, 0.0, 1.0); if (smoothAlpha <= 0.0) discard; FragColor = vec4(inputColor.xyz, alpha * smoothAlpha) ; }
shader_resources.RTV1_vertex_source:
#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; layout(location = 0) in vec4 aRectPoint; layout(location = 1) in vec3 aPointInfo; layout(location = 2) in float inputTextureID; layout(location = 3) in vec2 inputTilt; layout(location = 4) in vec2 inputDirection; uniform mat4 ProjectionMatrix; uniform float numTiles; out vec2 offset; out float opacity; out vec2 tilt; out vec2 direction; out vec2 fragCoord; void main(void) { gl_Position = ProjectionMatrix * vec4(aPointInfo.xy + aRectPoint.xy * aPointInfo.z, 0.0, 1.0); fragCoord = vec2(aRectPoint.z, aRectPoint.w); float textureID = floor(inputTextureID); offset = vec2((1.0 / numTiles) * mod(textureID, numTiles), (1.0 / numTiles) * floor(textureID / numTiles)); opacity = fract(inputTextureID) * 1000.0 / 255.0; tilt = inputTilt; direction = inputDirection; }
